purpose: Teach: 物産/書体/めずらしい/自然体/手際/フィッシング/題する/未読

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、地域の、本気で、絶対、物産、絶対、展、絶対、研究、絶対、ご縁、絶対、深めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to really dig into the local product expo. Build those connections seriously.
lines.style: Measured, direct authority. Opens with the name as anchor. Steady rhythm on the key demands. Warm underneath the precision — this is mentorship, not command.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、書体、絶対、見やすさ、絶対、工夫しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've been careful with the paper's typography and readability. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Not obsequious. Even pacing. Genuine gratitude without over-performance — he means what he's saying.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究テーマを、本気で、絶対、めずらしい、絶対、視点で、絶対、攻めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your research theme — approach it from an unusual angle. I want you to be bold.
lines.style: Clear instruction, slightly leaning forward. Conviction on 'unusual angle.' Not harsh, but there's steel underneath. He believes Ren can do this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。発表は、本気で、絶対、自然体、絶対、で、絶対、臨むつもりです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to present in a natural, grounded way. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Calm, self-assured without arrogance. Slightly slower than usual — he's making a commitment to himself and to his mentor. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実験の、本気で、絶対、手際、絶対、よく、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Keep your experimental process moving forward smoothly. Precision and pace both matter.
lines.style: Concise, matter-of-fact. No wasted breath. The tone of someone who has run experiments and knows what efficiency looks like. Practical warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学界での、本気for、絶対、フィッシング、絶対、メール、絶対、被害、絶対、警戒しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm staying alert about phishing and suspicious emails in academic circles. Thank you for the warning.
lines.style: Steady, vigilant. Shows he's taken the concern seriously. Not anxious, but alert. The gratitude is genuine and specific — he understands the real risk.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文を、本気で、絶対、題する、絶対、タイトル、絶対、印象的に、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make your paper's title stand out. It should arrest attention the moment someone reads it.
lines.style: Deliberate, purposeful. Slight emphasis on 'stand out' and 'arrest attention.' He's not just giving instruction — he's pushing Ren to think bigger about what impression means.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授からの、本気で、絶対、未読、絶対、メール、絶対、ない、絶対、よう、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've checked carefully — no unread emails from my professors. I'm staying on top of it. Thank you.
lines.style: Calm, conscientious. Shows he's being thorough without being anxious. Small breath before the final thanks — a moment of quiet satisfaction that he's handling this.
